conf.description: Forescout eyeExtend Connect Web API host-inventory pull (host-property, api-pull): hal+json response shaping - the Elastic Forescout package ships no collector or pipeline for this feed.

conf.comment: host-property/api-pull: shapes the JSON object a Cribl REST Collector receives per endpoint from GET /api/hosts (the Collector itself is a Source/Collector object, out of scope for this pipeline). hostname is preferred over nbthost for host.name per the documented multi-source ambiguity. mac normalized colon->dash uppercase. No timestamp field is documented for this feed, so no _time step is added (defaults to receipt time).

functions.description: why this is JSON reshaping rather than text parsing
batch every status:mapped/custom field that needed no further transform
mac normalization, hostname/nbthost precedence into host.name, event.dataset, cleanup
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
